resources.string: Jaro Preview checks for updates on GitHub. Your voice and words stay on this device. You can also download a larger speech model.
Allow the microphone, then choose Jaro Preview as your keyboard.
So Jaro Preview can hear you
Choose Jaro Preview in the list
Turn on Jaro Preview in Settings
Allow the microphone in Jaro Preview

Jaro processes speech and typing on this phone. Jaro Preview checks GitHub for a release manifest. GitHub receives the usual connection information, such as your IP address. Update checks do not include your audio, text, or vocabulary. Turn them off with Check for updates automatically.
Your browser downloads it from GitHub. Open the download and tap Update when Android asks. The first time, Android may ask you to allow your browser to install apps.
Updating closes the keyboard for a moment. Tap a text field to bring it back.
